description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget 'EditTaskScreen' for editing task details within a task management app. It includes UI for task name, note, reminder date/time, and list assignment. It interacts with the database to update tasks and fetches related data such as task lists.

classes.name: EditTaskScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget for editing an existing task, holding task properties and a callback to refresh task list.

classes.name: _EditTaskScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the UI and logic for editing tasks, including date/time pickers and database updates.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes controllers, fetches existing tasks and lists, and sets default date/time.

methods.name: refreshNotes
methods.description: Fetches all tasks and list data from the database.

methods.name: _selectDate
methods.description: Displays a date picker dialog to select a reminder date.

methods.name: _selectTime
methods.description: Displays a time picker dialog to select a reminder time.
